pages.text: A big Applied Energistics 2 expansion: universal buses, wireless channels, chunk power and mana nodes, and huge late-game multiblocks. SK-Tweaks replaces many recipes, so use HEI.
Late-game parts come from a $(item)Micro Singularity$(). Throw 64 AE2 Singularities and 4 Nether Stars on the ground, then hold a Nether Star and right-click an ME Controller.
